title: Donations to One Nation from two Gina Rinehart associates to be probed by electoral authorities
summary_full: Exclusive: Australian Electoral Commission to review $1m in donations to Pauline Hanson-led party from Adam Giles and Ian PlimerGet our daily political email, free app or daily news podcastMajor donations from close associates of One Nation’s billionaire benefactor, Gina Rinehart, will be reviewed by the Australian Electoral Commission (AEC) amid concerns they were made on behalf of a third party.The special minister of state, Don Farrell, said on Thursday that information about two $500,000 donations made to the Pauline Hanson-led party could be subject to further regulatory action if they are found not to comply with provisions in the Electoral Act.
